featured_reviews.name: Himanshi Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I don’t usually write long reviews, but this team deserves every word. I have never experienced this level of ease and peace of mind with any team that feels like family, before. Dhruv and Sourabh led an absolutely amazing team-experienced, prepared, and so deeply tuned in to every moment that mattered.

They didn’t just take photos; they made sure we lived our moments too. They would literally push my parents to step out of their Marwadi hospitality mode and actually enjoy their own celebration. They guided my CA couple to pose (which is honestly a task in itself!), and they did it with so much patience, warmth, and humour.

What touched me the most was how invested they were. I would have to force them to go eat because they were so focused on capturing everything perfectly. From late nights to early mornings, they showed up with the same energy, the same dedication, and the same big-hearted enthusiasm.

Their work ethic, their vibe, their passion — everything is admirable. My entire family is genuinely grateful that they were part of our celebration. They didn’t just capture our memories… they became a beautiful part of them.

Highly, highly recommended.

Great service overall. If something is out of stock, they process refunds quickly as well. Highly recommend don’t hesitate to buy from their site!

Highly recommended 👌

featured_reviews.name: Sav
featured_reviews.review_text: Their policies are not customer friendly at all. Charges are more than similar providers in Mulund. They charge for quick service and quick service TAT is almost 2 hrs. Similar quality work is undertaken at almost half the price by other providers. Had also given feedback to the staff at the shop. You do whatever, they will always want you to charge emergency rates.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: I appreciate your input however our service structure, including express service charges and TAT is transparently communicated! We focus on quality over shortcuts and our clients choose us exactly for that reason.

featured_reviews.name: Deepti Gaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The only saving grace of this store is the photographer, who is incredibly friendly and patient.

Unfortunately, the customer service from the lady at the front desk is highly unprofessional and rude. Additionally, the service offerings are disappointing: they refuse to cut photos into standard stamp or passport sizes, and the package forces you to take 44 pictures with very few options, leaving you with too many unwanted duplicates. To top it off, the pricing is not customer-friendly at all

featured_reviews.review_text:
Never recommend to anyone. Very expensive and only looting to customer.
I had very bad experience. I wanted to print 3.5 by 4.5 size photos where they said 150Rs for urgent I said ok.
I shared them 8 photos then said will be charges 50Rs per photo even though size is same.

Don't waste your money. Have more options nearby. Explore that.
